source.publication: 2025 Expanded Instructions (IA 1040) and the 2025 IA 1040 Iowa Individual Income Tax Return
source.section: IA 1040 form PDF p.1 Step 3 lines a, b, d; form PDF p.2 lines 1c, 2-5, 7, 8, 11, 12; Instructions PDF p.8 Step 3; PDF p.9-10 lines 2-4; PDF p.12 line 5 ('Iowa now has a flat tax rate of 3.8%'); PDF p.18 line 12; Schedule 1 line 7, PDF p.67-68 and form PDF p.5; Retirement Income Tax Guidance, 'Who qualifies'; PDF p.68 list of plans (IPERS, IRA, 401(k), Roth conversion income, IRC 402(a) annuities)

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (you) 70,000.00 + IRA distribution (you) 8,000.00 + employer plan distribution (you) 6,000.00 + Roth conversion (you) 7,000.00 + public pension paid by IA (you) 10,000.00 + qualified annuity (IRC 402(a)) (you) 5,000.00 = 106,000.00. Federal taxable income = 106,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 90,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). IA 1040 filing status 1 (single). Step 3 line a personal credits 1 x 40.00 = 40.00; line b 0 x 20.00 = 0.00 (65 or older on or before January 1, 2026; nobody blind); line c no dependents; line d and line 8 = 40.00. Line 1c federal AGI 106,000.00; line 2 federal taxable income 90,250.00. Schedule 1 line 7 column B: pension 10,000.00 of you (age 60, 55 or older on December 31, 2025) excluded; annuity 5,000.00 of you (age 60, 55 or older on December 31, 2025) excluded; IRA 8,000.00 of you (age 60, 55 or older on December 31, 2025) excluded; employer plan 6,000.00 of you (age 60, 55 or older on December 31, 2025) excluded; Roth conversion 7,000.00 of you (age 60, 55 or older on December 31, 2025) excluded; line 7 total 36,000.00. Schedule 1 line 21 net modifications = -36,000.00; line 3 = -36,000.00. Line 4 Iowa taxable income = 90,250.00 + (-36,000.00) = 54,250.00. Line 5 tax = 3.8% x 54,250.00 = 2,061.50; line 7 = 2,061.50. Line 11 total credits 40.00; line 12 balance = 2,061.50 - 40.00 = 2,021.50. State income tax 2,021.50 (no line 13-17 credits; line 19 school district or EMS surtax is local, not computed). The form allows whole-dollar rounding; expected keeps the cents. Low-income exemption test (PDF p.10-11): line 4 54,250.00 + federal deduction 15,750.00 = 70,000.00, against 9,000.00: not exempt. Single filers' tax reduction (PDF p.18): its worksheet 41-146 is not in the sources, so it is not applied. Every kind the rule names, all excluded with no cap: the IPERS pension (the public pension paid by IA), an IRC 402(a) annuity, an IRA, a 401(k) and a Roth conversion. Wages stay taxed.
accepted_approximations: The annuity kind is excluded whole at 55 or older, but nonqualified annuities and nonqualified deferred compensation do not qualify.
School district and county EMS surtaxes (a percentage of the tax, form line 19) are local and out of scope (issue #1).
